elec_turrets_short_desc: Connecting turrets to a wind turbine with a backup battery.
elec_turrets_desc: This is a classic scheme for connecting up to 9 automatic turrets from a single wind turbine. The turbine charges a large battery, which distributes power through splitters. The battery acts as a buffer — even if the turbine is destroyed during a raid, the turrets will continue firing.
elec_turrets_note: Ensure the wind turbine is placed high enough (at least 5-6 stories high) to output a stable 100+ rW of power.
elec_furnace_short_desc: Automatic turning on/off of furnaces when ore is loaded.
elec_furnace_desc: This scheme uses an industrial conveyor and electrical components to automatically turn on electric furnaces. The furnaces will only run when unsmelted ore is fed into them, which significantly saves battery power.
elec_furnace_note: The scheme works great with auto-sorting. The conveyor feeding the ore outputs an electrical signal, which we use to start the furnaces.
elec_raid_short_desc: Receives a push notification in Rust+ on your phone when a wall is destroyed.
elec_raid_desc: A reliable security system. Works on the principle of breaking a circuit. You install a Smart Alarm and connect it to a splitter. If the circuit is broken (for example, a wall with a wire or sensor is destroyed), the system sends a signal to the Smart Alarm and you get a notification in the Rust+ app.
elec_raid_note: Place the HBHF sensor so it doesn't react to players authorized in the tool cupboard (configure the sensor with a hammer).

mon_error_desc: Found an error in the guide or loot?
mon_note_rad: Radiation Note: Protection is required to visit this monument. A basic Hazmat suit provides 50 radiation protection, which is enough for most monuments except the top of the Launch Site.
elec_error_desc: Found an error or know a better scheme?
mon_airfield_short_desc: A large monument with hangars and an underground system. Includes a blue card puzzle.
mon_airfield_desc: Airfield is one of the most popular mid-tier monuments. It consists of three large hangars, a control tower, and an office building. The main loot is located in the underground tunnels, accessed through the hangars or the office building.
mon_airfield_puzzle_0: Insert the first fuse in hangar #1 (near the recycler) and turn on the timer.
mon_airfield_puzzle_1: Quickly run to the central office building.
mon_airfield_puzzle_2: Swipe the Green card at the terminal and go down to the basement.
mon_airfield_puzzle_3: In the basement, insert the second fuse.
mon_airfield_puzzle_4: Use the Blue card to access the main loot room, where military crates and a red key spawn.
mon_water_treatment_short_desc: A huge monument for farming basic resources. Only requires a blue card for the puzzle.
mon_water_treatment_desc: The Water Treatment Plant is a great place to farm scrap at the start of a wipe. The monument has a very simple puzzle and doesn't require a green card to access the main room (only blue). Most of the monument is safe, but the central building has radiation.
mon_water_treatment_puzzle_0: Find the two-story building with a switch on the second floor (near the spinning wheel). Turn the wheel and flip the switch.
mon_water_treatment_puzzle_1: Run to the central building with the blue door.
mon_water_treatment_puzzle_2: Insert a fuse into the fuse box on the second floor.
mon_water_treatment_puzzle_3: Swipe the Blue card to open the door.
mon_water_treatment_puzzle_4: Inside you will find military crates and a Red card.
mon_water_treatment_loot_2: Many basic crates and barrels around the area
mon_launch_site_short_desc: Top-tier monument. Guarded by Bradley, strong radiation, requires a red card to access elite loot.
mon_launch_site_desc: The Launch Site is one of the most difficult and profitable monuments in the game. The area is patrolled by the Bradley APC, and the main building is highly radioactive (the roof requires a hazmat suit + bandages or water, as radiation will accumulate even with a hazmat).
mon_launch_site_puzzle_0: Find the two small power buildings on the edges of the monument. Insert fuses into them and flip the switches.
mon_launch_site_puzzle_1: Run to the main launch shaft building.
mon_launch_site_puzzle_2: Swipe the Green card at the side entrance to enter the lower level.
mon_launch_site_puzzle_4: Swipe the Red card on the main access panel and climb the stairs to the roof.
mon_launch_site_puzzle_5: Elite crates are located on the roof. Press the button on the roof to take the elevator down.
mon_launch_site_loot_2: Loot from the Bradley tank (when destroyed)
mon_train_yard_short_desc: An industrial monument with high crate density and train car unloading mechanics. Medium radiation.
mon_train_yard_desc: The Train Yard is one of the most populated and profitable monuments on the island. Here you can find many useful objects, such as a recycler, pump jacks (refinery), and a train car unloading terminal.
mon_train_yard_puzzle_0: Kill the scientist in the Generator Building and flip the first switch.
mon_train_yard_puzzle_1: Quickly run to the Switch Tower, climb to the very top, and flip the second switch (you are on a timer!).
mon_train_yard_puzzle_2: Run to the Main Building, kill the scientist guarding the final switch and fuse slot.
mon_train_yard_puzzle_3: Insert a fuse and flip the switch.
mon_train_yard_puzzle_4: Go up to the blue door, swipe the Blue card.
mon_train_yard_puzzle_5: Inside the main room you will find up to 7 military crates and a Red card on the desk.
mon_train_yard_loot_0: Military Crates (up to 7x in the main building)
mon_train_yard_loot_1: Red Card (on the desk in the loot room)
mon_train_yard_loot_2: Many basic crates on yellow loaders and around train cars
mon_train_yard_sec_content_0: Train Yard is a Tier-3 monument that offers great loot but attracts many players. The best and most efficient route is to start with the Yellow Loaders and the back room behind the puzzle building. This allows you to gather up to three military crates and other loot in less than two minutes.
mon_train_yard_sec_content_1:
If you have a Green card and a Fuse, you can unload freight train cars for resources. First, you need a train and about 40 Low-grade fuel. Find train cars in the subway (tankers or open freight cars with ore) — empty boxcars are useless.

Drive the train into the Train Yard right under the unloading pipe. Then head to the Switch Tower using the green card and fuse. Use the buttons to lower the pump and extract the resources. They will drop into the tanks below the tower. Don't forget to loot the crates that drop on the ground when unloading ore.
mon_train_yard_sec_content_2:
Map legend:
1. Subway entrance
2. Train unloading zone
3. Generator building
4. Water tower
5. Crate spawn locations
6. Refinery
7. Train cars with crates
8. Switch tower
9. Main building (loot room)
10. Large yellow loader (near)
11. Large yellow loader (far)
12. Red pipes
13. Loot room backyard
mon_military_tunnels_short_desc: An underground monument guarded by NPC scientists. Elite loot, full preparation required.
mon_military_tunnels_desc: Military Tunnels is a dangerous PVE/PVP zone. Inside are many armed NPC scientists. This is the only monument where all three cards (Green, Blue, Red) are needed for a full clear.
mon_military_tunnels_puzzle_0: You will need: Green, Blue, Red cards and 1 fuse.
mon_military_tunnels_puzzle_1: Kill the scientists at the entrance and descend into the tunnels.
mon_military_tunnels_puzzle_2: Swipe the Green card in the right section of the tunnels. Flip the switch and insert the fuse.
mon_military_tunnels_puzzle_3: Go deeper, swipe the Blue card.
mon_military_tunnels_puzzle_4: In the final section near the train car, swipe the Red card. Elite loot awaits inside.
mon_military_tunnels_loot_2: Loot from NPC scientists (syringes, components, ammo)
mon_large_oil_rig_short_desc: An offshore monument. Heavy scientists event, locked crate, top-tier loot.
mon_large_oil_rig_desc: The Large Oil Rig is one of the most popular monuments for clans. It has no radiation, but is guarded by regular and heavy scientists. A Red card is required to activate the elite event.
mon_large_oil_rig_puzzle_0: Clear the monument of blue NPC scientists, climbing from the lower decks to the very top.
mon_large_oil_rig_puzzle_1: Green and Blue cards are needed to open intermediate doors with regular loot.
mon_large_oil_rig_puzzle_2: At the very top, swipe the Red card.
mon_large_oil_rig_puzzle_4: At this moment, a Chinook helicopter will arrive and drop off Heavy Scientists. Fight them off and wait 15 minutes for the crate to open.
mon_dome_short_desc: A massive spherical tank. Requires parkour skills to climb to the very top for 4 military crates.
mon_dome_desc: The Dome is a popular monument for parkour that doesn't require any keycards. Inside and out are pipes and platforms you must use to climb to the very top. Be careful, falling is deadly!
mon_dome_puzzle_0: Find the ladders or pipes on the outer perimeter.
mon_dome_puzzle_1: Jump across pipes and metal structures to climb inside.
mon_dome_puzzle_2: At the very top of the sphere, on the roof, there are 4 military crates.
mon_dome_puzzle_3: You can go down the same way or carefully slide down the outer pipes.
mon_dome_loot_0: 4 military crates at the very top
mon_dome_loot_1: Basic crates and barrels on the lower tiers and around the sphere
mon_arctic_base_short_desc: A snowy monument guarded by scientists on snowmobiles. Cold, lots of loot.
mon_arctic_base_desc: The Arctic Research Base is a large monument in the snow biome. It is guarded by a large number of scientists and also offers the opportunity to get a free snowmobile.
mon_arctic_base_puzzle_0: Clear the base of NPC scientists.
mon_arctic_base_puzzle_1: A blue card is required to access the snowmobile.
mon_arctic_base_puzzle_2: Swipe the card on the garage door to get the loot and a fully fueled snowmobile.
mon_arctic_base_loot_2: A large number of basic crates and meds
mon_sewer_branch_short_desc: Underground parkour and a simple green card puzzle. A great start for beginners.
mon_sewer_branch_desc: Sewer Branch is a basic monument, perfect for getting a blue card and farming starting scrap.
mon_sewer_branch_puzzle_0: Find the brick building with a switch and turn it on.
mon_sewer_branch_puzzle_2: Swipe the Green card at the door to get inside.
mon_sewer_branch_puzzle_3: Inside you'll find crates and a Blue card.
mon_sewer_branch_loot_1: Military and basic crates in the restricted zone
mon_satellite_dish_short_desc: A small monument with two destroyed antennas. Features a green card puzzle.
mon_satellite_dish_desc: Satellite Dish is a great location to start. It includes two giant antennas, under one of which a research table is hidden. The puzzle is very simple.
mon_satellite_dish_puzzle_0: Insert a fuse into the power shack and flip the switch.
mon_satellite_dish_puzzle_1: Run over to the other shack and swipe the Green card.
mon_satellite_dish_puzzle_2: Take the Blue card and the loot.
mon_small_harbor_short_desc: A coastal monument with containers. The simplest green card puzzle.
mon_small_harbor_desc: Small Harbor is a basic, radiation-free location, ideal for fresh spawns. The Cargo Ship often arrives here.
mon_small_harbor_puzzle_0: Place a fuse in the two-story building and turn on the power.
mon_small_harbor_puzzle_1: Use the Green card in the shack between the containers to get a Blue card.
mon_large_harbor_short_desc: An enlarged version of the harbor. More crates, same basic green card mechanic.
mon_large_harbor_desc: Large Harbor is similar to the small one, but covers a larger area with more cranes and hangars.
mon_large_harbor_puzzle_0: Insert a fuse and turn on the electricity.
mon_large_harbor_puzzle_1: Swipe the Green card in the cabin to get a Blue card.
mon_large_harbor_loot_1: More basic crates than in the small harbor
mon_power_plant_short_desc: Two large cooling towers, high radiation in the center, and a complex puzzle.
mon_power_plant_desc: The Power Plant contains a lot of loot but requires good radiation protection, as some areas (like inside the cooling towers) have a very high radiation background.
mon_power_plant_puzzle_0: Activate the first switch on the edge of the monument.
mon_power_plant_puzzle_1: In the central three-story building, start the timer and swipe the Green card.
mon_power_plant_puzzle_2: Inside, flip the main switch and insert the fuse.
mon_power_plant_puzzle_3: Exit the building and run to the adjacent one, swipe the Blue card to access the final loot.
mon_junkyard_short_desc: A maze of rusty cars with a magnetic crane that can recycle vehicles into scrap.
mon_junkyard_desc: Junkyard is a unique monument where you can use a giant magnetic crane to pick up and shred old cars. In return, you will receive a huge amount of scrap and other resources.
mon_junkyard_puzzle_1: Pour Low-grade fuel into the magnetic crane and drive it around, recycling cars.
mon_junkyard_puzzle_2: Collect the loot from the car shredder at the base of the crane.
mon_excavator_desc: Giant Excavator and Mining Quarries are used for passively mining a huge amount of resources (HQM, Sulfur, Stone, Metal). They require Diesel Fuel to operate.
mon_excavator_puzzle_0: Pour diesel fuel into the tank.
mon_excavator_puzzle_1: Start the engine (at the Excavator, you also need to select the type of ore to mine in the control room).
mon_excavator_puzzle_2: Wait and collect ore from the collection points, defending yourself from other players.
mon_excavator_loot_0: Hundreds of thousands of ore units (Stone, Sulfur, Metal, HQM)
mon_supermarket_short_desc: A small abandoned store. A great starting place, here you can find a green card.
mon_supermarket_desc: The Abandoned Supermarket is an ideal monument to start the game. There is no radiation, but there is basic loot, a recycler, and a chance to grab a Green card from the desk in the back room.
mon_supermarket_puzzle_1: Grab the Green access card from the desk.
